files.title: 230926 Final Honours Course B.Tech Biotechnology
files.programme: Honors in Artificial Intelligence - Machine Learning (AI-ML) & Bioinformatics, B. Tech Biotechnology

units.title: Programming Fundamentals (Python)
units.topics: Introduction to programming and problem-solving, Python overview, environment setup (Jupyter/Colab), variables & data types, operators & expressions, control structures (if -else, loops), functions (definition, parameters, scope), modules & imports, basic input /output, string handling (slicing, concatenation, formatting)

units.title: Data Structures & File Handling
units.topics: Lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets, file I/O (read/write/append), parsing structured text files, record -based biological file formats (FASTA/FASTQ/PDB used purely as parsing examples), regular expressions for pattern matching, exception handling

units.title: Scientific Computing Basics
units.topics: NumPy arrays & operations, Pandas (Series, DataFrames, data cleaning), brief introduction to Biopython (Seq object, SeqIO for reading sequence files)

units.title: Data Retrieval & Developer Tools
units.topics: Accessing biological data through APIs (NCBI Entrez, UniProt REST), command-line and Linux basics, version control with Git/GitHub

units.title: Data Visualization
units.topics: Data visualization with Matplotlib & Seaborn (line plots, bar charts, histograms, scatter plots), plotting techniques for biological data

subjects.title: Python Programming and Data Handling Lab

units.title: Genomics & NGS Data Analysis
units.topics: NGS overview and sequencing platforms, FASTQ file format in depth, quality control of sequencing reads, read alignment/mapping basics, variant calling fundamentals, introduction to RNA-seq analysis workflow

units.title: Programmatic Access to Biological Data
units.topics: Accessing biological data via APIs (NCBI Entrez, UniProt REST), JSON/XML parsing of API responses, web scraping for biological data collection, automating bulk data retrieval, advanced Biopython (transcription, translation, reverse complement, sequence object handling)

units.title: Multi-Omics Data Integration & Comparative Genomics
units.topics: Introduction to multi -omics (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics), transcriptomic data handling basics, pathway analysis fundamentals, whole -genome comparison techniques, comparative genomics case studies

units.title: Advanced Structural Bioinformatics
units.topics: Homology modeling concepts, molecular dynamics basics, molecular docking in practice (AutoDock or similar tools), protein-protein interaction analysis, structural bioinformatics case studies

units.title: Sequence Alignment: From Concept to Code
units.topics: Implementing Needleman-Wunsch and Smith-Waterman algorithms in Python, scoring matrices in code (PAM/BLOSUM), automating BLAST searches programmatically, multiple sequence alignment via scripting (Biopython wrappers)

units.title: Introduction to ML & Biological Data
units.topics: Machine learning fundamentals, supervised and unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning overview, biological datasets and problem formulation, data cleaning and preprocessing, normalization and encoding, introduction to feature engineering for biological data, Scikit-learn workflow.

units.title: Supervised Learning for Biological Data
units.topics: Linear and logistic regression, K-nearest neighbors, support vector machines, Naive Bayes, decision trees and random forests, classification and prediction using biological datasets, biomarker classification, feature importance and interpretation, biological case studies.

units.title: Unsupervised Learning & Dimensionality Reduction
units.topics: Clustering: K -means, hierarchical clustering and DBSCAN, dimensionality reduction: PCA and t - SNE/UMAP, high -dimensional biological datasets, single -cell RNA -seq data analysis: clustering and visualization, biological interpretation of computationally identified patterns.

units.title: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
units.topics: Artificial neural networks and deep learning fundamentals, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for biological data, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for biological sequence analysis, introduction to graph neural networks (GNNs), applications of deep learn ing in genomics, proteomics and drug discovery, biological case studies.

units.title: Model Evaluation and Predictive Modeling
units.topics: Training, validation and test datasets, cross -validation, overfitting and underfitting, hyperparameter tuning, performance metrics for classification and regression, confusion matrix, precision, recall, F1 - score, ROC -AUC, model interpretation and feature i mportance, predictive modeling using integrated biological data, biological case studies.

units.title: Transformers and Foundation Models for Biological Data
units.topics: Attention mechanism, transformer architecture, self -attention, positional encoding, pretrained models, transfer learning, biological language models, protein and DNA language models, applications in sequence analysis

units.title: Generative AI for Biomolecular Design
units.topics: Generative AI concepts, variational autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, diffusion models, protein sequence generation, molecular generation, AI-assisted protein and enzyme design, applications in drug discovery

units.title: Multimodal AI Applications
units.topics: Introduction to multimodal AI, integration of biological, clinical and imaging data, multimodal representation learning, combining omics and clinical information, applications in precision medicine and drug discovery

units.title: AI Applications in Healthcare and Biotechnology
units.topics: AI-assisted medical diagnosis, medical image analysis, disease risk and prognosis prediction, treatment response prediction, AI -assisted drug discovery, protein and enzyme engineering, applications in synthetic biology and biotechnology

units.title: Ethics, Regulation and Responsible AI
units.topics: Ethical considerations in AI -enabled healthcare and biotechnology, data privacy and security, bias and fairness in AI systems, explainability and interpretability, reliability and limitations of generative AI, intellectual property considerations, regulato ry frameworks for AI -based healthcare applications, responsible deployment and human oversight

files.title: 280926 Double Minors Course B.Tech Biotechnology
files.programme: Double Minor in Food, Wine & Dairy Technology, B. Tech Biotechnology

units.title: Fundamentals of Biology and Cell Biology
units.topics: Importance of biology in engineering, characteristics of living organisms, organization of life, prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, cell structure and functions, cell organelles, plant and animal cells, cell membrane and transport, basic cellular processes

units.title: Biomolecules and Enzymes
units.topics: Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, biological functions of biomolecules, structure and properties of carbohydrates, proteins and lipids, introduction to enzymes, enzyme classification, mechanism of enzyme action, factors affecting enzyme activ ity, enzyme inhibition, industrial applications of enzymes

units.title: Microbiology and Microbial Growth
units.topics: Introduction to microbiology, classification of microorganisms, bacteria, fungi, yeast and viruses, microbial cell structure, beneficial and harmful microorganisms, microbial nutrition, microbial growth, microbial growth curve, factors affecting microbial growth, microbial contamination and control

units.title: Genetics and Molecular Biology
units.topics: DNA and RNA structure and functions, genes and chromosomes, central dogma, mutations and genetic variation, introduction to recombinant DNA technology, applications of biotechnology

units.title: Basic Biotechnology and Bioprocessing
units.topics: Introduction to biotechnology, industrial biotechnology, fermentation and its types, batch and continuous processes, basic fermentation parameters, inoculum and starter cultures, bioreactors and their basic components, sterilization and aseptic processing, downstream processing, case studies of bioprocessing

units.title: Introduction to Food Science
units.topics: Food industry and its scope, classification of foods, nutritional components of food, physical and chemical properties of food, sensory characteristics of food, water activity, pH, food spoilage, mechanisms and types of spoilage, factors affecting food spoilage, food spoilage microorganisms

units.title: Food Processing and Preservation
units.topics: Preliminary processing, cleaning, sorting, grading, peeling, size reduction, thermal processing, blanching, pasteurization, sterilization, UHT treatment, refrigeration, freezing, drying and dehydration, canning, irradiation, microwave processing, high-pressure processing, food additives, packaging and storage

units.title: Food Fermentation and Biotechnology
units.topics: Role of microorganisms in food production, food fermentation, starter cultures, fermented foods, microbial production of food ingredients, microbial enzymes in food processing, food flavour production, microbial production of oils and fats, solid-state fermentation, traditional fermented foods, probiotics and functional foods

units.title: Food Quality and Safety
units.topics: Food quality parameters, sensory evaluation, food adulteration, food contaminants, foodborne microorganisms, food safety, good manufacturing practices (GMP), HACCP, quality assurance, shelf - life evaluation, food safety management, FDA and FSSAI

units.title: Food Processing Waste and Emerging Technologies
units.topics: Classification and characterization of food industry waste, solid and liquid waste, physical, chemical and biological treatment, activated sludge process, anaerobic treatment, value addition of food waste, sustainable food processing, emerging food processing technologies, smart and active packaging

units.title: Viticulture and Wine Science
units.topics: History and evolution of winemaking, major wine -producing regions, grapevine biology, grape composition, important grape varieties, factors affecting grape quality, grape maturity and harvesting, harvesting equipment and grape handling systems, wine classi fications and types, red wine, white wine, rosé, sparkling and fortified wines.

units.title: Wine Production Technology
units.topics: Grape harvesting, grape reception units, crushers, destemmers and conveyors, must preparation, maceration tanks and presses, pressing, must clarification and treatment, wine yeast and starter cultures, yeast selection and inoculation, fermentation tanks and temperature-control systems, pumps and filtration systems, alcoholic fermentation, red/white winemaking process

units.title: Wine Fermentation, Chemistry and Maturation
units.topics: Wine microorganisms, alcoholic and malolactic fermentation, factors affecting fermentation, temperature and pH control, fermentation -derived metabolites: sugars, organic acids and alcohols, phenolic compounds and tannins, colour, flavour and aroma compound s, wine maturation, oak barrels and stainless-steel ageing tanks, barrel ageing, bottle ageing, clarification, stabilization

units.title: Wine Quality Analysis and Regulations
units.topics: Wine quality, sensory evaluation, wine tasting, aroma and flavour profiling, wine defects, off -flavours, physicochemical analysis, FSSAI regulations, alcoholic beverage standards, wine labelling requirements, State Excise regulations, OIV standards, Codex Alimentarius, international wine standards

units.title: Wine Packaging, Sustainability and Industry
units.topics: Wine bottling and packaging, bottle filling and corking/capping machines, labelling machines and packaging lines, packaging materials and closures, storage and cellar management, wine labelling, wine preservation, wine tourism, sustainability in viticultur e and winemaking, by -product utilization, recent industry trends and emerging technologies

units.title: Milk Science and Dairy Chemistry
units.topics: Dairy industry overview, composition and nutritional value of milk, physical and chemical properties, milk proteins and casein, milk fat and lactose, minerals and colloidal nature of milk, factors affecting milk composition, raw milk collection, sampling, transportation and hygienic milk production

units.title: Milk Processing Technology
units.topics: Milk reception and quality assessment, filtration and clarification, cooling, separation, standardization, homogenization, pasteurization, sterilization and UHT processing, evaporation and concentration, membrane processing, microfiltration, ultrafiltratio n and reverse osmosis, spray drying, processing of toned, double-toned, standardized and flavoured milk

units.title: Dairy Products and Fermentation Technology
units.topics: Starter cultures and lactic acid bacteria, dairy fermentation, fermented and probiotic milk products, cream and butter, buttermilk, paneer, cheese manufacture, coagulation and curd formation, cheese ripening and maturation, ice cream and frozen desserts, condensed milk, milk powder

units.title: Dairy Quality, Microbiology and Safety
units.topics: Microflora of milk, beneficial, spoilage and pathogenic microorganisms, microbial defects, milk quality parameters, pH and acidity, fat, protein, total solids and SNF, milk adulteration, microbial quality assessment, shelf-life evaluation, food safety, GMP, HACCP, quality assurance and dairy standards

units.title: Dairy Engineering, Packaging and Sustainability
units.topics: Dairy processing equipment, heat exchangers, homogenizers, separators, evaporators and spray dryers, refrigeration and cold chain, Clean -in-Place (CIP), packaging materials and methods, storage and transportation, dairy waste management, waste treatment an d by-product utilization, water and energy management, sustainable dairy processing, emerging dairy technologies
